LumaTable.description_en: The EventHouse data table information bound to the Luma Agent, including column definitions and data retention policy
LumaTable.description_zh: Luma Agent 绑定的 EventHouse 数据表信息，包含列定义与保留策略

Catalog.description_en: The name of the data catalog to which the table belongs
Catalog.description_zh: 表所属的数据目录名称
Catalog.title: 所属数据目录

Columns.description_en: The list of column definitions for the table. Each column contains Name (column name), Type (data type), and Comment (comment)
Columns.description_zh: 表的列定义列表。每列包含 Name（列名）、Type（数据类型）、Comment（备注）

Type.description_en: The data type of the column
Type.title: 列数据类型

Columns.title: 列定义列表

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the table. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 表的创建时间（Unix 时间戳，毫秒）
CreateTime.title: 创建时间

Name.description_en: The unique name of the event table
Name.description_zh: 事件表的唯一标识名称
Name.title: 表名称

Namespace.description_en: The name of the namespace to which the table belongs
Namespace.description_zh: 表所属的命名空间名称
Namespace.title: 所属命名空间

RetentionPolicy.description_en: The data retention policy, including the retention days for hot data and cold data
RetentionPolicy.description_zh: 数据保留策略。包含热数据和冷数据的保留天数

ColdTTL.description_en: The number of days to retain cold data in low-cost archival storage
ColdTTL.description_zh: 冷数据保留天数，低成本归档存储
ColdTTL.title: 冷数据保留天数

HotTTL.description_en: The number of days to retain hot data in high-performance query storage
HotTTL.description_zh: 热数据保留天数，高性能查询存储
HotTTL.title: 热数据保留天数

RetentionPolicy.title: 数据保留策略

UpdateTime.description_en: The last update time of the table. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 表的最后更新时间（Unix 时间戳，毫秒）
UpdateTime.title: 更新时间

LumaTable.title: Luma 绑定数据表

description_en: Lists all event tables bound to a Luma Agent in a specified namespace. Returns the complete set of bindings without pagination
description_zh: 列出 Luma Agent 在指定命名空间下绑定的全部事件表。返回的是绑定关系的全集，不分页
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge list-luma-tables --agent-name my_agent --catalog my_catalog --namespace my_namespace --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLumaTables

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaCatalogs to obtain the catalog name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的数据目录名称。可通过 ListLumaCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaNamespaces to obtain the namespace name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的命名空间名称。可通过 ListLumaNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100. Each entry requires a back-to-origin metadata query, so this value also limits the number of back-to-origin queries per call
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大数据条数。取值范围 1~100，不传时默认 100。每条记录都需回源查询一次元数据，因此该值同时限制单次调用的回源次数
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The starting token for a paging query. Leave this parameter empty or set it to "0" for the first query. For subsequent pages, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的起始Token。首次查询不传或传 "0"；后续翻页使用上一次响应中返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates a successful call. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The list of event tables bound to the agent, including entries and pagination information
Data.description_zh: Agent 绑定的事件表列表，包含条目与分页信息

Limit.description_en: The effective page size for this request. If the Limit parameter is not specified, the server default value is used. If the specified value exceeds the upper limit, the value is adjusted to the maximum allowed value
Limit.description_zh: 本次请求实际生效的每页数量。未传 Limit 时为服务端默认值，超出上限时为收敛后的值
Limit.title_en: 本次请求实际生效的每页数量
Limit.title_zh: 本次请求实际生效的每页数量

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. Pass this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request to retrieve the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页起始Token，传入下次请求的 NextToken 可获取下一页；为空表示已无更多数据
NextToken.title_en: 下一页Token，为空表示已是最后一页
NextToken.title_zh: 下一页Token，为空表示已是最后一页

Tables.description_en: The list of event tables bound to the agent
Tables.description_zh: Agent 绑定的事件表列表

items.description_en: The details of a single data table, including column definitions and the data retention policy
items.description_zh: 单个数据表的详细信息，包含列定义与保留策略

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of event tables bound to the agent, regardless of the number of entries returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: Agent 绑定的事件表总数，与本页返回条数无关
TotalCount.title_en: Agent 绑定的事件表总数
TotalCount.title_zh: Agent 绑定的事件表总数

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value Operation success is returned if the call succeeds. A specific error description is returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of this request, which is used for troubleshooting and ticket submission
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates a successful call
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
